headings.rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings. Use fluid scales up to text-6xl.

mono.rules: Use for data tables, metrics, and incident IDs.

spacing_and_layout.grid: Control Room Grid (tight gaps gap-4 or gap-6, dense data).
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6 to p-8 for cards) to let data breathe.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid borders for definition, minimal reliance on shadows. Use Grid Borders (The Technical Look) for data-heavy sections.

components.buttons: Flat solid colors, 1px border. Hover state should darken the hue.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px border (#E2E8F0), no shadow. Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-md).
components.forms: Shadcn UI forms. Minimalist borders. Labels must be bold and concise.
components.tables: Shadcn/UI or custom. Zebra-striped or 1px border bottom. Use JetBrains Mono for numbers. Sparklines for trends.
components.charts: Shadcn chart components (Recharts). Color-blind-friendly palettes using the accent colors.
components.navigation: Sidebar Navigation (collapsible). Active state: Light blue background with primary color text and left border indicator.

motion.hover: Subtle border color change, text color change, or -translate-y-1 on cards.

images.usage: Use as a split-screen background on the login/authentication page to convey a clean, corporate structure.

images.description: Two women using laptops in a corporate setting
images.usage: Use in 'Training Management' empty state or 'About' page if one exists, to add a human element.
Can be used as a subtle banner background for the 'Welcome back' section on the main KPI dashboard, overlaid with heavy white gradient to maintain text readability.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Outfit, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Use standard lucide-react icons for the sidebar navigation and action buttons.
Implement a 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Prioritize data density but maintain clarity.
The UI must feel like an authoritative compliance tool. No playful borders or excessive shadows. Rely on 1px borders and high contrast.
Implement Shadcn UI extensively for the tables, dialogs (for Hazard Matrix and Incidents), forms (for Checklists), and Charts (for KPI Dashboard).
All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-audit').
For the Document Management module, use an organized list or table view with clear version numbers in JetBrains Mono font.
Highlight non-compliance, hazards, and accidents using the hazard accent color (#D90429) to draw immediate attention.
